stem.en: Do you mind ___ the window? It's very cold.

why.en: Mind is followed by the -ing form: Do you mind closing...?
why.uz: Mind dan keyin feʼlning -ing shakli keladi: Do you mind closing...?
why.ru: После mind используется форма на -ing: Do you mind closing...?

stem.en: My parents agreed ___ me a new laptop for my birthday.

why.en: Agree is followed by to + the base verb: agreed to buy.
why.uz: Agree dan keyin to + feʼlning asosiy shakli keladi: agreed to buy.
why.ru: После agree используется to + начальная форма: agreed to buy.

stem.en: I'm looking forward ___ you next week.

why.en: In look forward to, to is a preposition, so the verb after it takes -ing: to seeing.
why.uz: Look forward to da to — predlog, shuning uchun undan keyingi feʼl -ing oladi: to seeing.
why.ru: В look forward to частица to — предлог, поэтому глагол после неё с -ing: to seeing.

stem.en: She managed ___ the exam even though she was ill.

why.en: Manage is followed by to + the base verb: managed to pass.
why.uz: Manage dan keyin to + feʼlning asosiy shakli keladi: managed to pass.
why.ru: После manage используется to + начальная форма: managed to pass.

stem.en: My cousin, ___ lives in Namangan, is a doctor.

why.en: Commas show extra information about a person; that cannot be used here, so who.
why.uz: Vergullar shaxs haqida qoʻshimcha maʼlumotni ajratadi; bu yerda that ishlatilmaydi, shuning uchun who.
why.ru: Запятые выделяют дополнительную информацию о человеке; that здесь нельзя, поэтому who.

stem.en: Our new teacher, ___ name is Ms Karimova, is very kind.

why.en: Whose shows possession (her name); who's means who is.
why.uz: Whose egalikni bildiradi (uning ismi); who is ning qisqa shakli bu yerga toʻgʻri kelmaydi.
why.ru: Whose выражает принадлежность (её имя); who's значит who is.

stem.en: The laptop, ___ I bought last month, is already broken.

why.en: Extra information about a thing between commas uses which, not that.
why.uz: Vergullar orasidagi narsa haqidagi qoʻshimcha maʼlumot which bilan beriladi, that bilan emas.
why.ru: Дополнительная информация о предмете в запятых вводится which, а не that.

instructions.ru: Выберите вариант, который правильно заполняет пропуск.

options.en: My bike, that I love, is old.
The boy who sits next to me is funny.
I met a woman whose son plays chess.
This is the park where we met.

why.en: That cannot start a clause between commas: My bike, which I love, is old.
why.uz: Vergullar orasidagi ergash gap that bilan boshlanmaydi: My bike, which I love, is old.
why.ru: Придаточное в запятых не может начинаться с that: My bike, which I love, is old.

stem.en: I studied hard; ___, I didn't pass the test.

why.en: However links two sentences with opposite ideas and is followed by a comma.
why.uz: However qarama-qarshi fikrdagi ikki gapni bogʻlaydi va undan keyin vergul qoʻyiladi.
why.ru: However связывает два предложения с противоположным смыслом, после него ставится запятая.

stem.en: We stayed at home ___ the bad weather.

why.en: Before a noun (the bad weather) we use because of; because needs a subject and verb.
why.uz: Ot oldidan (the bad weather) because of ishlatiladi; because dan keyin ega va feʼl kerak.
why.ru: Перед существительным (the bad weather) — because of; после because нужны подлежащее и глагол.

stem.en: ___ she was tired, she finished her essay.

why.en: Even though + subject + verb shows contrast; despite needs a noun or -ing.
why.uz: Even though + ega + feʼl qarama-qarshilikni bildiradi; despite dan keyin ot yoki -ing kerak.
why.ru: Even though + подлежащее + глагол выражает контраст; после despite нужно существительное или -ing.

stem.en: It was late, ___ we took a taxi home.

why.en: Taking a taxi is the result of it being late, so we use so.
why.uz: Taksiga chiqish kech boʻlganining natijasi, shuning uchun so.
why.ru: Взять такси — следствие того, что было поздно, поэтому so.

why.ru: Для расписаний будущее выражается Present Simple: the train leaves at 6:15.

stem.en: What ___ this weekend? — I'm visiting my grandparents.

why.en: The answer is a fixed plan in the present continuous, so the question is the same: are you doing.
why.uz: Javob Present Continuous dagi aniq reja, savol ham shunday: are you doing.
why.ru: Ответ — договорённость в Present Continuous, значит и вопрос такой же: are you doing.

stem.en: I've decided. I ___ study medicine at university.

why.en: A decision already made is an intention: am going to + verb.
why.uz: Allaqachon qabul qilingan qaror — niyat: am going to + feʼl.
why.ru: Уже принятое решение — намерение: am going to + глагол.

stem.en: ___ I open the window for you?

why.en: To offer help with I or we, we use Shall I...?
why.uz: I yoki we bilan yordam taklif qilishda Shall I...? ishlatiladi.
why.ru: Чтобы предложить помощь с I или we, используется Shall I...?
